Crimson Desert Enhanced: Charting the Unknown - Official Launch Trailer
About Crimson Desert  
Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Pearl Abyss. A devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent. The Greymane Kliff is determined to reunite with his surviving comrades and rebuild what was lost. But on a journey where alliances are forged, dangers abound, and mysterious factions are uncovered, Kliff comes to realize that an unprecedented threat and a destiny greater than he imagined await him.

text:
Agni: Village of Calamity | Blood and Bones Trailer
A missing friend, a forbidden Indonesian village, a rogue agent driven by guilt.

AGNI: Village of Calamity is a cinematic survival horror, combining mind-bending terror and ritual strangeness, with Indonesian slasher style violence.

Inspired by the classic survival horror of the early Resident Evil era, with modern day 'Remedy' style storytelling and Silent Hill psychological horror.

Operating with limited resources, Agni must solve environmental puzzles and survive relentless pressure as grotesque horrors stalk her through the darkness. Every encounter is dangerous. Every bullet matters.

AGNI: Village of Calamity delivers a suffocating descent into trauma and grief, where reality is unstable, violence is brutal, and some truths should never be uncovered.

text:
The Wolf Among Us Remastered | Launch Trailer | Available Now
The Big Bad Wolf is back, and he's got unfinished business. A murder in Fabletown. A sheriff with a dark past. A conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of 1980s New York, and every choice Bigby makes on the way to the truth will follow him.

The Wolf Among Us Remastered is the definitive edition of Telltale's acclaimed detective thriller. Every corner of Fabletown has been revisited with enhanced environments, improved character fidelity, upgraded lighting, refined animations, and remastered audio. Uncover five playable deleted scenes restored from the original 2013 production, play the entire story in the all-new Noir Mode, and explore more than 100 pieces of artwork and over an hour of developer interviews. All five original episodes are included.

For the first time, defining choices you make in The Wolf Among Us Remastered will carry forward into The Wolf Among Us 2, coming in 2027. Sign in to your Telltale Account while you play to seamlessly bring those choices into the next season of Bigby's story. Played the original? You can set your past choices at the start of The Wolf Among Us 2, no replay required. However you lived it, The Wolf Among Us 2 will remember.

Fairy tales are real. Murder is just the beginning.
